title: Get the Brand Profiles for your TTO account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the existing Brand Profiles for your TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/brand/profile/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | | brand_profile_ids | string[] | The IDs of existing Brand Profiles to filter the results by.

Max size: 20. | | page | number | Current page number.

Value range: ≥ 1.
Default value: 1. | | page_size | number | Page size.

Value range: 1-100.
Default value: 10. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/brand/profile/get/?tto_tcm_account_id={{tto_tcm_account_id}}&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|brands | object[] | List of Brand Profiles. | ##|brand_profile_id | string | The ID of the Brand Profile. | ##|brand_name | string | Brand name. | ##|brand_industry | string | The ID of the brand industry. | ##|brand_website | string | Brand website link. | ##|logo_url | string | The URL of the brand logo image for your TTO Creator Marketplace account.

Note: This URL is system-generated for the logo image and is different from the URL specified through `logo_url` in the request for Brand Profile creation. | ##|tiktok_account_url|string|The URL of your TikTok account.

If no TikTok account URL is provided for creating the Brand Profile, this field will be an empty string (`""`).| #| page_info | object | Page information. | ##|page | number | Current page number. | ##|page_size | number | Page size. | ##|total_number | number | Total number of results. | ##|total_page | number | Total number of pages. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "brands": [ { "brand_industry_id": "10102102000", "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "brand_profile_id": "{{brand_profile_id}}", "brand_website": "{{brand_website}}", "logo_url": null }, { "brand_industry_id": "17103000000", "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "brand_profile_id": "{{brand_profile_id}}", "brand_website": "{{brand_website}}", "logo_url": "{{logo_url}}" } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 100, "total_number": 2, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ```
seo_title: Get the Brand Profiles for your TTO account via API
seo_description: Use this endpoint to retrieve the existing Brand Profiles for your TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.
